obligations.ask: Return confirmation that the parking charge details are correct

results.segment: Confirmation that the parking charge details are correct must be returned within 49 days of the date of this letter.
The parking charge will be reviewed by our assessment team, and a decision is to be issued within 30 days.
This notice is issued for information and no reply is needed to it.
An assessment concluded on 26 February; its findings are attached for information.
